name: Lookout Lorna

intro.text: Sixty years I've watched the horizon from this cave. Not for the mutineers' reasons, mind. For the ship with the post on it. I know a sail when I see one, and I know a challenger when I see one. You are both.

win: Well. Wasn't expecting a sail on a Tuesday.
after: The horizon here is a great deal of nothing. It's the best thing about the place. Look after it.
